result.title: The Geometry of Lies: Knowledge and Persona Directions for Detecting Deception in Large Language Models
result.summary: Linear probes are the cheapest LLM lie detectors but often fail to transfer across kinds of lie. Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a published persona bank with roles that deny knowledge they have, plus honest counterparts. At each model's middle layer the resulting persona direction ranks lies across Liars' Bench better than single-dataset probes on three of its four models; it fails on Qwen, even when Qwen stays in role far more often. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct it beats directions from a random persona bank, but its gain over the published direction is within the range of random widenings. On lies about knowledge, persona directions mainly track a reply's wording: where lies and honest denials share their words, our three main contrasts stay inside the random-direction band on Llama and Qwen and reach only its edge on Gemma, though on Mistral one clears it. A knowledge direction contrasts questions the model can answer with ones nobody can, each followed by the same scripted denial. It separates lies from identical honest denials on two models and narrowly on a third, but not on the fourth; its other results partly depend on the benchmark's wording. On the Gender-Secret fine-tune it clears the band by a few hundredths on Llama and fails on Mistral. The sum of the two directions ranks lies better than a supervised probe at the same depth on all four models (on one, both near chance) but is level with the persona direction on Llama's average and behind that probe on held-out lies. More varied role-play questions do not help the persona direction on Liars' Bench.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在 70B 规模上检验由诚实／欺骗角色扮演得到的无标注 persona 方向以及「知识」方向能否区分 LLM 的谎言，并发现这些方向往往只在措辞层面起作用，多数增益落在随机方向波动范围内。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用对照刺激构造内部方向、并以随机方向带和措辞混淆作为基线」的解读流程，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态究竟编码视觉内容还是表层措辞；但研究对象是文本欺骗而非多模态推理，迁移仅为线索。
